Accent for FluxUI chrome: unit frames, bars, and borders. This options window uses it for the selected page, the active tab, toggles, and sliders. Extra button slots follow their category scope.

Account-wide shares settings across all characters. Character-specific lets this character override with its own settings (copied from account on first switch). Action bar layout has its own Settings scope on the Action Bars tab.
FPS, ping, durability, and stats pinned from the character panel. These toggles are always per character. Where the whole panel sits is on the Layout tab.
Drag a row to change the order inside the panel. Newly pinned stats are added at the end.

Used when Layout places the panel on the status bar. Left, between, and right are columns on the horizontal status row. On the stacked status bar under the micro menu, the same choice is the top row, the row after the first bar, or the bottom row.
Click a colored box to move it. Faded tiles are other spots. Gray boxes are reference only.

Drag buttons in the preview to set order. Use the strip under each icon to cycle Off -> Account -> Character -> Off per row - that visibility is stored separately and is not affected by the bar scope below.
Layout tab -> Layout settings scope only affects where the bar sits (and columns for position 2), not this list or size.

Learned professions as micromenu buttons (open that trade skill). Default order is just before the Addons (+) button. Visibility and layout for trade skills are always character-only (Off/Character in the preview). Drag reorder still applies.
Fixed split: primary professions appear as individual micro buttons; secondary skills open from the Trade Skills flyout.
Countdown digits use the same Flux 12px overlay as Classic on every client. Size: edit FLUX_NAMEPLATE_AURA_COUNTDOWN_SCALE in NamePlates/Countdown.lua (default 0.75), then /reload.
The game's own Progressive / Flash / Health Bar Color threat display (nameplateThreatDisplay). Flux writes these bits with SetCVarBitfield only.
Flux draws a threat-colored border and your threat rank and percent (100% = you have aggro) on enemy NPC nameplates. Enemy players targeting you get a red border.

Gold per character is stored with Flux inventory awareness (or Syndicator, if that addon is loaded) and shown on this bar tooltip. If you have deleted a character, pick them here and remove the row so they never appear in the list again. For your current character, the row reappears the next time your gold amount changes.
Hide experience bar when not gaining XP

Gold, experience, and reputation strips share one height. Layout placement (under menu vs bottom strip) stays on the Layout tab. Gold bar item tracking (up to six item counts) is always per character, regardless of the Status bar settings scope below.
Show item currency on gold strip

Per character (not account-wide). Icons in a grid: drag to reorder, drag from bags to assign, cursor + click to place, right-click a slot to clear. Counts on the gold strip appear when the main toggle is on and you have at least one of that item.
On this client, Honor and Arena can be shown on the gold strip. These toggles are stored per character (same as the PVP panel checkboxes).
